critical_path_summary.staffing_implication: Backend Developer and QA Engineer must be dedicated (not shared) across all phases; Frontend Developer can support Phase 1 design and Phase 4 testing with 3–5 days slack.

phases.name: Discovery & Design
milestones: Stakeholder alignment on gateway scope and success metrics
Microservice inventory and authentication standard documented
API gateway architecture and design approved
Technology stack and team skill assessment completed

tasks.name: Conduct stakeholder alignment session and define success metrics
tasks.definition_of_done: Success metrics documented and signed off by stakeholders; adoption plan outlined.

tasks.name: Document microservice inventory, authentication standard, and load balancing strategy
tasks.definition_of_done: Service inventory list, auth method (OAuth 2.0/JWT/mTLS), load balancing algorithm, and RPS targets documented and validated with stakeholders.

tasks.name: Perform user research and define personas for internal development teams
tasks.definition_of_done: Persona document with use cases and pain points for gateway consumers.

tasks.name: Assess team skill gaps and technology stack fit
tasks.definition_of_done: Team skill matrix and training plan (if needed) documented; stack selection confirmed.

tasks.name: Design API gateway architecture, request flow, and authentication integration
tasks.definition_of_done: Architecture diagram, request flow diagram, auth integration design, and rate limiting strategy documented and approved.

tasks.name: Design gateway UI/dashboard for monitoring and configuration
tasks.definition_of_done: Wireframes and UI mockups for gateway dashboard and admin panel.

phases.name: Core Development
milestones: Sprint 1: Core request routing and authentication implemented
Sprint 2: Rate limiting and load balancing implemented
Sprint 3: Logging and monitoring integrated
Internal demo: All core features working end-to-end
Backlog refinement for Phase 3 edge cases and integrations

tasks.name: Set up gateway project structure, CI/CD pipeline, and local development environment
tasks.definition_of_done: Git repo initialized, CI/CD pipeline (build, test, deploy) functional, all team members can run gateway locally.

tasks.name: Implement core request routing logic and service discovery (static or dynamic)
tasks.definition_of_done: Gateway accepts HTTP requests, routes to correct microservice based on path/header, returns response; handles 5+ test services.

tasks.name: Implement authentication/authorization integration with auth service
tasks.definition_of_done: Gateway validates JWT/OAuth tokens, rejects unauthorized requests, passes auth context to downstream services.

tasks.name: Implement rate limiting per client (token bucket or sliding window)
tasks.definition_of_done: Rate limits enforced per client ID; requests exceeding limit return 429 status; limits configurable.

tasks.name: Implement load balancing across service instances (round-robin or least-connections)
tasks.definition_of_done: Requests distributed evenly across 2+ service instances; health checks detect and skip unhealthy instances.

tasks.name: Implement request/response logging to logging service
tasks.definition_of_done: All requests logged with timestamp, client ID, service, method, path, status, latency; logs sent to logging service.

tasks.name: Implement API versioning support (header or path-based routing)
tasks.definition_of_done: Gateway routes requests to correct API version based on Accept-Version header or /v1/, /v2/ path prefix.

tasks.name: Build gateway monitoring dashboard and health check endpoint
tasks.definition_of_done: Dashboard displays request rate, latency, error rate, service health; /health endpoint returns gateway and downstream service status.

tasks.name: Develop gateway UI/dashboard frontend (React/Vue/Angular)
tasks.definition_of_done: Dashboard displays metrics, logs, service status; admin panel allows rate limit and routing configuration.

tasks.name: Conduct internal demo and gather feedback on core features
tasks.definition_of_done: Demo completed with stakeholders; feedback documented; backlog updated for Phase 3.

phases.name: Integration & Edge Cases
milestones: Sprint 4: Edge cases and error handling implemented
Sprint 5: Security hardening and compliance checks completed
All integrations tested with real microservices
Security review and penetration testing completed

tasks.name: Implement error handling, retry logic, and circuit breaker pattern
tasks.definition_of_done: Gateway handles service timeouts, connection errors, and cascading failures; circuit breaker prevents thundering herd; retries configurable.

tasks.name: Implement request/response transformation and header manipulation
tasks.definition_of_done: Gateway can add/remove/modify headers, transform request/response payloads, and inject correlation IDs.

tasks.name: Implement caching layer for frequently accessed endpoints
tasks.definition_of_done: Caching (Redis or in-memory) reduces latency for cacheable requests; TTL and cache invalidation configurable.

tasks.name: Conduct security hardening: input validation, SQL injection prevention, XSS protection
tasks.definition_of_done: Input validation rules applied; no SQL injection or XSS vulnerabilities detected in security scan; OWASP Top 10 checklist completed.

tasks.name: Implement TLS/SSL encryption for gateway-to-service communication
tasks.definition_of_done: All gateway-to-microservice communication encrypted; certificate management and rotation automated.

tasks.name: Integrate with real microservices and test end-to-end flows
tasks.definition_of_done: Gateway tested against 5+ real microservices; all use cases (UC1–UC7) validated; no integration blockers.

tasks.name: Conduct security review and penetration testing
tasks.definition_of_done: Security review completed; penetration test report generated; critical/high vulnerabilities remediated.

tasks.name: Implement request tracing and distributed logging (OpenTelemetry or similar)
tasks.definition_of_done: Request traces captured end-to-end; logs correlated by trace ID; traces queryable in monitoring dashboard.

phases.name: QA & Testing
milestones: All critical bugs resolved
Performance and load testing completed
UAT with internal development teams completed
Accessibility check (WCAG 2.1 AA) passed
Documentation and runbooks written

tasks.name: Execute comprehensive functional test suite (unit, integration, end-to-end)
tasks.definition_of_done: Test suite covers all use cases; >80% code coverage; all critical and high-priority bugs resolved.

tasks.name: Conduct performance and load testing (target RPS, latency, throughput)
tasks.definition_of_done: Load test results show gateway meets RPS and latency targets; bottlenecks identified and documented.

tasks.name: Perform accessibility audit (WCAG 2.1 AA) on gateway dashboard
tasks.definition_of_done: Dashboard passes WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility audit; keyboard navigation and screen reader support verified.

tasks.name: Conduct UAT with internal development teams (representative end users)
tasks.definition_of_done: UAT completed with 2+ internal teams; sign-off obtained; feedback incorporated or deferred to Phase 5.

tasks.name: Write API documentation, runbooks, and troubleshooting guides
tasks.definition_of_done: API docs (OpenAPI/Swagger), deployment runbook, troubleshooting guide, and FAQ published; reviewed by team.

tasks.name: Create adoption plan and training materials for internal teams
tasks.definition_of_done: Adoption plan (communication, training, rollout schedule) documented; training materials (slides, videos, demos) prepared.

tasks.name: Identify and document post-launch owner and maintenance plan
tasks.definition_of_done: Post-launch owner named; maintenance SLA, on-call rotation, and escalation path documented.

phases.name: Deployment & Handoff
milestones: Production deployment completed
Smoke testing in production passed
Go-live sign-off obtained

tasks.name: Deploy gateway to production environment
tasks.definition_of_done: Gateway deployed to production; all services accessible through gateway; no deployment errors.

tasks.name: Execute smoke testing in production (critical paths, health checks)
tasks.definition_of_done: Smoke tests pass; gateway health check returns 200; all critical use cases verified in production.

tasks.name: Obtain go-live sign-off from stakeholders and post-launch owner
tasks.definition_of_done: Go-live sign-off email received from stakeholders and post-launch owner; project closure checklist completed.
